content.what_this_is: This is a reminder from Fenwick Borough Council that you have not paid a council tax instalment of £212.50.
what_to_do: Pay £212.50 to the council by 17 November 2026.
Pay the full amount to avoid enforcement action and extra costs of £70.
Call the council on 0300 000 0000 if you cannot pay.
Or visit fenwick.example/ctax to arrange a payment plan.
Ask about a council tax reduction if you are on a low income.

by_when.what: Pay the £212.50 instalment in full (within 7 days of the notice dated 10 November 2026)

amounts.what: Unpaid council tax instalment, due 1 October 2026
Additional costs if you do not pay in time

steps.text_en: This is a reminder from Fenwick Borough Council. You have not paid a council tax instalment.
steps.picture_prompt: A person at a kitchen table looking at a letter, with a small town hall building in a speech bubble above the letter

steps.text_en: Pay £212.50 to the council by 17 November 2026.
steps.picture_prompt: A hand giving coins and notes to a smiling council worker at a desk

steps.text_en: Pay the full amount to avoid enforcement action. This is when the council takes steps to make you pay. You also avoid extra costs of £70.
steps.picture_prompt: A full purse next to a closed gate with a stop hand sign, and a small pile of extra coins crossed out

steps.text_en: Call the council on 0300 000 0000 if you cannot pay.
steps.picture_prompt: A person holding a telephone to their ear while sitting on a sofa

steps.text_en: Visit fenwick.example/ctax to arrange a payment plan.
steps.picture_prompt: A person using a laptop at a table, with a calendar and small coin stacks beside it

steps.text_en: Ask about a council tax reduction if you are on a low income.
steps.picture_prompt: A person talking with a council worker, with a small coin stack shrinking beside them

steps.text_en: Pay the £212.50 instalment in full by 17 November 2026. This is 7 days after the notice dated 10 November 2026.
steps.picture_prompt: A wall calendar with one day circled in red and a letter lying beside it

steps.text_en: Unpaid council tax instalment, due 1 October 2026. The amount is £212.50.
steps.picture_prompt: A house with a coin stack in front of it and a calendar page beside it

steps.text_en: Extra costs if you do not pay in time. The amount is £70.
steps.picture_prompt: A small extra pile of coins added on top of a larger pile, next to a clock

steps.text_en: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.
steps.picture_prompt: a person on the phone talking to a helper
